caption_L1: This is a line graph named Number of recreational visitors to the Korean War Veterans Memorial in the United States from 2008 to 2019 (in millions). The y-axis plots Number of visitors in millions while the x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: The chart shows a fluctuational trend. Between 2008 and 2010 we can see that the number of people visiting Korean War Weteran Memorials in the USA dropped by around of half of million people, from around 3.6 million to around 3.1 million. In between 2010 and 2013 the number of visitors stayed relatively the same, but it started to grow in 2014, reaching it's peak in 2017 where the Korean War Weteran Memorials in the USA had around 4.15 millions visitors. In 2018 the number started to drop.
